name: Murf
tagline: Murf is an AI voice generation studio that produces professional-quality voiceovers in 120+ voices across 20 languages without recording equipment. Presenters choose from a library of realistic voices, adjust pitch and speed, sync the audio to video, and export broadcast-ready audio in minutes. eLearning developers, product teams, and content marketers use Murf to localise and voice content at a fraction of studio rates.
